=== SKILL: avoid_modifying_test_files ===
---
name: avoid_modifying_test_files
description: Use this skill when working with test files to ensure compliance with project rules.
---
1. Always create new test files instead of modifying existing ones in the `tests/` directory.
2. Ensure that any changes to tests are documented and that the original test files remain unchanged.
3. Review the project guidelines regarding test file modifications before making any changes.

=== SKILL: handle_file_not_found_errors ===
---
name: handle_file_not_found_errors
description: Use this skill when encountering file not found errors during data processing tasks.
---
1. Check the file path for typos or incorrect directory structures.
2. Ensure that the required files are present in the specified directory before executing the code.
3. Implement error handling in your code to gracefully manage `FileNotFoundError` exceptions, providing informative messages to the user.

=== SKILL: enforce_type_annotations ===
---
name: enforce_type_annotations
description: Use this skill when defining public functions to ensure compliance with type hinting rules.
---
1. Review all public functions in your codebase to ensure they have type annotations for all parameters and return values.
2. Use a consistent format for type hints, following the project's style guide.
3. Run static analysis tools to check for missing type annotations and address any issues identified.
